summary: Well‑executed preregistered paired study with full archived artifacts showing a very small guarded benefit (0.5 pp) vs baseline under shared_initial_candidate semantics; primary McNemar test non‑significant (p=0.0625). Strong reproducibility provenance and adherence to preregistered design, but manuscript must correct reference/citation formatting and condense the Disclosure Statement to comply with track rules; clarify primary vs secondary inferential claims about the bootstrap CI vs the preregistered McNemar test.
critical_issues: References and in‑text citation formatting do not follow the track/IEEE requirement: prose uses bare DOIs/arXiv identifiers instead of numbered IEEE citations and the manuscript does not present a conventional IEEE bibliography with full bibliographic metadata (authors, title, venue, year) for each cited source. This violates the mandatory reference-format rule and prevents straightforward verification of citation semantics.

Disclosure Statement content duplicates execution/logging detail beyond the concise disclosure allowed by the track. The Disclosure must retain the single mandatory master_prompt locator+SHA‑256 but must not reproduce execution paths, per‑artifact paths, or manifest/log duplications in manuscript prose. The current Disclosure therefore fails the track's concision requirement.
required_revisions: Replace all inline DOI/arXiv/plain‑URL citations in narrative prose with IEEE‑numbered citation markers and include a conventional IEEE numbered References section containing full, verified bibliographic metadata (authors, title, venue, year, DOI/arXiv) for every referenced record. Ensure each numbered citation actually supports the immediately adjacent claim; where it does not, weaken the claim to match the verified record.

Condense the Disclosure Statement so it is concise and does not reproduce execution manifests, per‑file paths, or run logs. Preserve exactly one immutable master_prompt locator (provenance/master_prompt.txt) and its full SHA‑256 digest in the Disclosure as required; move other run‑level provenance details (artifact lists, manifest paths, long hashes) to the archived artifact bundle and refer to that bundle only, with no manifest duplicates in the paper body.

Explicitly state (in Methods or Results) that the preregistered primary inferential procedure is the exact McNemar two‑sided test and that therefore the confirmatory conclusion follows that test (H1 not supported at two‑sided α=0.05). Explain the observed discordance with the bootstrap percentile CI (which the preregistration also computed) and clearly label the bootstrap CI result as secondary/illustrative so the manuscript does not imply a conflicting primary confirmatory significance claim.
optional_revisions: Add a single compact table or parenthetical note listing the paired contingency counts (n11, n10, n01, n00) in the main text near the primary result to aid reader interpretation (these appear in the archive but a short inline reference is helpful).
Briefly summarize the validator rule‑set and repair trigger logic (one concise paragraph) or cite the archived validator spec so readers can assess construct validity without inspecting full logs.
Shorten other background prose to free space for the required citation/bibliography formatting if page count is tight.
